title: He Hears My Voice
traveler_why: Tonight is a story about whispering for help in a frightening moment, and Beau the Brave is the Traveler who trusts Heavenly Father to hear him when things feel hard.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he trusts Heavenly Father to hear him when things feel hard. In Beau’s world today: Beau got lost from Dad for a scary minute at the busy store. His heart pounded, but he remembered to whisper, “Heavenly Father, help me,” and stay put. Soon Dad came around the corner! “Heavenly Father heard me,” Beau said. Just like the person who called out and was heard, Beau learned that Heavenly Father listens the moment we call.
